## Design

### 2026-10-05 — Im working on my very first PCB, it's a version of Starbie and curently i have started on making the basic design.  Then in my future updates i will add in more parts to make it more advanced and make

**2h**

Im working on my very first PCB, it's a version of Starbie and curently i have started on making the basic design.  Then in my future updates i will add in more parts to make it more advanced and make the firmware for the board.

![Skärmbild 2026-10-05 193616](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KOP0tTce7oXCIV1XpjIz1uBprKUChpK3/aeefe7cc0f9272dc9ea847cc6f95732d8aab9cc9d9ee1d295d21217a4c23a35d.png)

First i started by making the scematic. Firstly the ESP32. First i tought i should route the components in this stage but then i figured out that i should make it as indevidual parts.

![Skärmbild 2026-10-05 193817](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KOP0tTce7oXCIV1XpjIz1uBprKUChpK3/5ed75c360173df34f4dbe7e6f2a286e11cad83450a648c0cf4faf2c04cc42103.png)

I then completed the buttons and other smaller parts and get them ready for laying them out on my board.

![Skärmbild 2026-10-05 200337](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KOP0tTce7oXCIV1XpjIz1uBprKUChpK3/a136e945a59dcb6401520e2bdc403a5ad17aee97d074b8142ce07c44b1dedcc9.png)

I also hade some problems with conecting the scematics to the actual layout but i looked up a tutorial and figured out how to connect them.

![Skärmbild 2026-10-05 204023](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KOP0tTce7oXCIV1XpjIz1uBprKUChpK3/2d1785d448de2688cb5bd44fbf9ce04ca773907ff39a3889c9f1fb06e5e38364.png)

I then continued by laying out the components in a kind of sus configuration. This was a really fun part so far.

![Skärmbild 2026-10-05 205723](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KOP0tTce7oXCIV1XpjIz1uBprKUChpK3/719528f35423f79d9e5ba4888319bfc4b62469ee512827d612d90051716f52f9.png)

Then i did the routing of the bord which was enjoeble but also i had to redo the ESP32 lines since i put it upp side down.

![Skärmbild 2026-10-05 211041](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KOP0tTce7oXCIV1XpjIz1uBprKUChpK3/4b5ed1873854492a6832ec665b23c15d34c2c32ceba8a23610949171dda44480.png)

Then the last part was to do a gnd fill of the entire board which turnd out great

In general this was a really fun first session and it has been very enjoyable to lern how pcbs are designd from the ground upp
